# Lucide Swift — Full Documentation for AI Assistants

> Generated for LLM context. See llms.txt for a concise version.
> Package: https://github.com/ajaxjiang96/lucide-swift.git
> Version: 0.7.4 | Lucide Icons: 1.21.0

## Overview

LucideSwift is a vector-first, type-safe Swift package for Lucide Icons with native
SwiftUI support. It converts SVG path data into native SwiftUI `Shape` conformances,
providing true vector rendering at any size without pixelation.

Key differentiator vs other Lucide Swift packages: this package generates pure Swift
Shape code from SVG paths rather than bundling image assets (PDFs/PNGs). This means:
- True vector rendering at any resolution
- Compile-time verification of icon names
- Xcode autocomplete for all 1,738+ regular icons + 374 Lab icons
- ~7× faster enum lookup vs bundle-based image lookup
- ~2× faster rendering vs PDF rasterization

## Package URL and Installation

```
Package URL: https://github.com/ajaxjiang96/lucide-swift.git
Minimum version: 0.2.0
Swift tools version: 5.9
```

### Swift Package Manager

Add to your `Package.swift`:
```swift
dependencies: [
    .package(url: "https://github.com/ajaxjiang96/lucide-swift.git", from: "0.7.4")
]
```

Then add `"LucideSwift"` to your target's dependencies array.

Or via Xcode: File → Add Package Dependencies → enter the repository URL.

## Requirements

- Swift 5.9+
- SwiftUI (not UIKit/AppKit compatible)
- iOS 14+, macOS 11+, tvOS 14+, watchOS 7+, visionOS 1+

## Architecture

### Core Components

1. **LucideShape** — SwiftUI `Shape` protocol implementation. Every icon is a struct
   conforming to `Shape` via `LucideShape`. Accessible as `Lucide.<iconname>`.
2. **LucideIcon** — SwiftUI `View` wrapper. Primary public API. Four initializers:
   - `LucideIcon(.iconName)` — type-safe enum
   - `LucideIcon(lab: .iconName)` — Lab (experimental) icons
   - `LucideIcon(name: "string")` — string lookup with fallback
   - `LucideIcon(shape: LucideShape)` — from pre-constructed shape
3. **LucideGenerator** — Command-line tool in `Tools/Sources/LucideGenerator/`.
   Fetches icons from `lucide` and `lucide-lab` GitHub repos, parses SVG paths,
   generates Swift source files. Run via `swift run --package-path Tools LucideGenerator`.

### File Layout

```
Sources/LucideSwift/
├── LucideIcon.swift           # Unified icon View + Label extensions
├── Lucide.swift               # LucideShape definition
├── Image+Lucide.swift         # Image(lucide:) extensions
├── Lucide+Generated.swift     # Auto-generated enums (DO NOT EDIT)
└── Icons/                     # ~2,102 files, one per icon
Tests/LucideSwiftTests/
Tools/
├── Sources/LucideGenerator/
│   ├── main.swift             # Code generation entry point
│   └── SVGPathParser.swift    # SVG path command parser
├── Sources/PreviewGenerator/
└── Tests/LucideGeneratorTests/
```

### SVG Path Commands Supported

M/m (move), L/l (line), H/h (horizontal line), V/v (vertical line),
C/c (cubic bezier), Z/z (close path), Q/q (quadratic bezier — via conversion),
T/t (smooth quadratic — via conversion), S/s (smooth cubic — via conversion),
A/a (elliptical arc — via conversion).

## Full API Reference

### LucideIcon

```swift
// Type-safe enum (recommended)
LucideIcon(_ iconName: LucideIconName,
           style: LucideIconStyle = .stroked,
           size: CGFloat = 24,
           color: Color? = nil,
           strokeWidth: CGFloat = 2,
           absoluteStrokeWidth: Bool = false)

// Lab (experimental) icons
LucideIcon(lab iconName: LucideLabIconName,
           style: LucideIconStyle = .stroked,
           size: CGFloat = 24,
           color: Color? = nil,
           strokeWidth: CGFloat = 2,
           absoluteStrokeWidth: Bool = false)

// String-based with fallback
LucideIcon(name: String,
           style: LucideIconStyle = .stroked,
           size: CGFloat = 24,
           color: Color? = nil,
           strokeWidth: CGFloat = 2,
           absoluteStrokeWidth: Bool = false)

// From Shape
LucideIcon(shape: LucideShape,
           style: LucideIconStyle = .stroked,
           size: CGFloat = 24,
           color: Color? = nil,
           strokeWidth: CGFloat = 2,
           absoluteStrokeWidth: Bool = false)
```

### Parameters

- `style`: `.stroked` (default) or `.filled` (experimental, may produce artifacts)
- `size`: Icon size in points (default: 24)
- `color`: Icon color. nil = inherits from environment foreground color
- `strokeWidth`: Stroke width multiplier (default: 2)
- `absoluteStrokeWidth`: When true, stroke stays constant regardless of icon size

### Label Integration

```swift
Label("Settings", lucide: .settings)
Label("Save", lucide: LucideLab.save)
// In buttons, menus, toolbars — full SwiftUI Label conformance
```

### Image Creation

```swift
Image(lucide: .house)
    .resizable()
    .frame(width: 48, height: 48)
```

### LucideShape (Native Shape)

```swift
Lucide.house.stroke(Color.red, lineWidth: 2)
Lucide.star.fill(Color.yellow)
    .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
```

### Icon Name Conversion

Upstream Lucide uses kebab-case. This package converts to lowerCamelCase for Swift:
- `arrow-right` → `LucideIconName.arrowRight`
- `circle-x` → `LucideIconName.circleX`
- `a-arrow-down` → `LucideIconName.aArrowDown`

### Version Info

```swift
LucideVersions.libraryVersion     // e.g., "0.7.4"
LucideVersions.lucideVersion      // e.g., "1.21.0"
LucideVersions.lucideLabVersion   // e.g., "abc1234"
```

## Technical Details

- Generated Code: ~140K lines of Swift path data across ~2,102 files
- Build Time: Parallel compilation of individual icon files scales across all cores
- Runtime Memory: `static let` paths cached on first access; negligible diffing overhead
- Binary Size: ~42.3 MB (full icon set, linker includes all due to switch-dispatch)

## Benchmarks (vs lucide-icons-swift PDF asset catalog)

| Metric | LucideSwift (Shape) | lucide-icons-swift (Assets) |
|--------|---------------------|---------------------------|
| Binary Size | 42.3 MB | 4.9 MB |
| Lookup (avg) | 1.3 µs | 9.6 µs |
| Render (per icon) | 4.2 µs | 9.3 µs |
| Memory (all icons) | 4.7 MB | 6.5 MB |

## Versioning Strategy

Dual versioning:
- `.library-version` — Semver for the Swift library API (e.g., 0.7.4)
- `.lucide-version` — Upstream Lucide icons version (e.g., 1.21.0)
- `.lucide-lab-version` — Upstream Lucide Lab commit SHA
- Auto-increments patch on icon sync; major/minor bumped manually for breaking changes

## CI/CD

`.github/workflows/sync-and-release.yml`:
- Runs daily (00:00 UTC) and on manual trigger
- Checks upstream Lucide + Lucide Lab for updates
- If new version: runs generator, bumps patch, commits, tags, creates GitHub Release
- Record snapshot baselines for visual regression testing

## Notes for AI Coding Assistants

- NEVER edit `Sources/LucideSwift/Lucide+Generated.swift` or files under
  `Sources/LucideSwift/Icons/` — they are auto-generated. Run
  `swift run --package-path Tools LucideGenerator` to regenerate.
- Test with: `swift test` (full suite) or `swift test --filter LucideSwiftTests/TestName`
- Build with: `swift build` (debug) or `swift build -c release` (release)
- Use `@testable import LucideSwift` in tests for internal access
- The tools package has a patched dependency at `Tools/PatchedDependencies/SVGPath` for SVG parsing
- File headers follow a standard format (see AGENTS.md for details)
